title: findings.json (argument of submit)
description: Agent answer. A violation of this schema (wrong type, missing field, exceeded limit) => reward -1. Also checked by the grader: episode_id equals the episode. An unknown type string, currency or ID is structurally valid but never matches (false positive). Unknown keys are ignored. Grader 2.0.0, schema_version 1.0.

finding.description: Unknown extra keys (e.g. confidence) are allowed and ignored by the grader.

type.description: one of duplicate_invoice, payment_allocation, fx_conversion, period_cutoff; any other string never matches

claimed_amount_minor.description: integer minor units. JSON Schema 2020-12 treats 100.0 as an integer; the grader (auditgym.grader.validate) is stricter and rejects any float, even 100.0

explanation.description: short justification; never read by the grader
